- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-12-15 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 685: Linux Kernel 2.4.28/2.6.9 - 'scm_send Local' Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2004-12-14, verified=1)

- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 686: Linux Kernel 2.4.22-28/2.6.9 - 'igmp.c' Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2004-12-14, verified=1)
